notes.title: Bug Fixes and a New Feature: Adjustable Camera Movement
notes.content:
Here it is a brand new update solving problems, fixing little anoying bugs, and implementing hole new features thank to your feedback! 

Various refinements to enhance gameplay and gamefeel. And the most important 2 new features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002261/5ff9a848da8c4047cc1c4c43fa9a2c44b831167a.png[/img]

• Adjustable Camera Movement: Customize the camera movement sensitivity for a more comfortable experience, best suited to your eyes.

• Center Dot Option: A small visual guide, also to prevent motion sickness.


A huge thank you to everyone who shared their feedback! Your input makes all the difference and helps me keep improving the game for you!
